faqs.q: How does SiteFlow handle offline data entry?
faqs.a: Field crews can log tasks and progress offline from the mobile app; data syncs to the central project when connectivity returns.

faqs.q: Can I integrate with existing ERP systems?
faqs.a: SiteFlow is built to sit alongside your finance and accounting stack; discuss integration paths such as Tally and Zoho Books with the team.

faqs.q: What is the typical implementation timeline?
faqs.a: Implementation depends on your project count and modules enabled; the team will scope a rollout plan during onboarding.
